player.badge.tier.diamond: A badge tier, named after its metal. The tiers rise bronze, silver, gold, ruby, diamond.
player.badge.tier.gold: A badge tier, named after its metal. The tiers rise bronze, silver, gold, ruby, diamond.
player.badge.tier.platinum: The fourth badge tier, between gold and diamond. Called Ruby on screen.

player.badge.track.earned: Under the Badges heading: how many of the badges shown the player holds. wraps the number earned, drawn as a figure.
player.badge.track.held: The badge tier the player holds. {tier} is a tier name (Bronze to Diamond).
player.badge.track.maxed: Beside a tiered badge whose top tier (Diamond) is held: nothing left to climb.
player.badge.track.notEarned: In place of a held tier when the player has not earned the badge.
player.badge.track.rarity: In a badge's popover. {share} is a percentage already formatted, like 12% or <0.1%.
player.badge.track.soFar: In a badge's popover: the player's count so far, and how many more reach the next tier. Each wraps a figure.
player.badge.track.tierAt: Tooltip on a badge tier: the tier's name and the count it takes.
player.badge.track.tiers: Screen-reader name for the list of a badge's five tiers.
player.badge.track.toNext: How far a badge is from its next tier. {tier} is a tier name (Bronze to Diamond); wraps the number, drawn as a figure.
player.badge.traveler.criteria: How the achievement badge is earned, shown beside its name. The tier thresholds are drawn separately.
player.badge.traveler.name: Name of an achievement badge. A playful title rather than a description; translate the spirit, and keep it short.
player.badges.scope: Under the Badges heading: badges are not scoped to a community.
player.badges.viewSwitcher: Accessible name of the switch between the profile's tiered badges and its other badges.
player.banned.body: Notice to staff on a banned player's profile; {name} is the placeholder name everyone else sees.
player.banned.title: Title of the notice to staff on a banned player's profile.
player.board.of: After a rank, the size of the board it is on, as in "#3 of 120".
player.claim.again: Button: claim a player again after a declined request.
player.claim.claimed: On a player's profile: an account has claimed this player.
player.claim.declined: On a player's profile, to the viewer whose claim was refused.
player.claim.pending: On a player's profile, to the viewer whose claim awaits a moderator.
player.claim.public: Beside the claim button on a player's profile, in words a 13-year-old can read. "What else" is the optional details a claimed player can add, like country, pronouns and avatar. A link to the privacy notice follows it.
player.claim.request: Button: ask a moderator to link this player to the viewer's account.
player.criteria.blurb.events: Beside the filter word events: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.gain: Beside the filter word gain: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.main: Beside the filter word main: in a player table's filter list, saying what it narrows by. Lower case, no full stop: a description, not a sentence.
player.criteria.blurb.played: Beside the filter word played: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.rank: Beside the filter word rank: in a player table's filter list; the board is the community's ranking. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.rating: Beside the filter word rating: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.rd: Beside the filter word rd: (rating deviation) in a player table's filter list: how sure the board is of a rating. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.region: Beside the filter word region: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.criteria.blurb.winrate: Beside the filter word winrate: in a player table's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
player.h2h.empty: Head-to-head with no sets; {a} and {b} are the two players.
player.h2h.empty.title: Title of the empty head-to-head.
player.h2h.everySet: Heading over the list of sets between two players.
player.h2h.minChars: Opponent search, before enough has been typed.
player.h2h.notFound: Head-to-head: the chosen opponent does not exist.
player.h2h.pick: Head-to-head before an opponent is chosen.
player.h2h.recent: Heading over suggested opponents the player met recently.
player.h2h.samePlayer: Head-to-head: the chosen opponent is this player.
player.h2h.scope: Under the Head-to-head heading: the record is not scoped to a community.
player.h2h.searchShort: Placeholder of the opponent search when there are no recent opponents.
player.h2h.vs: Between the two players' scores in a head-to-head.
player.h2h.won: Screen-reader word after the winner's name in a set row, as in "Hyhy won 3–0 Daze".
player.highlights.attendance: How many tournaments the player has entered; # is the count, grouped in the viewer's locale.
player.highlights.best: Heading over the player's best finishes.
player.highlights.best.row: Accessible name of a best-result row: {place} is an ordinal (1st), {field} the field size, {event} the event; {movement} says whether the rating went up (gained) or down (lost) by {amount}, or is none.
player.highlights.column.gained: Best results column: rating gained at that tournament.
player.highlights.peak: Label of the player's highest rating.
player.highlights.peakIn: Names the community whose rating a figure is; {community} is the community.
player.highlights.scope: The scope line over a player's highlights when read outside any community; {attendance} is the attendance sentence.
player.highlights.scopeAll: The scope line over a player's highlights when read inside a community, saying the figures span every community; {attendance} is the attendance sentence.
player.highlights.wins: Heading over the best players this player has beaten.
player.highlights.wins.column.player: Notable wins column: the opponent beaten.
player.highlights.wins.column.rank: Notable wins column: the opponent's rank.
player.highlights.wins.column.set: Notable wins column: the set's score.
player.highlights.wins.rankLabel: Screen-reader word before an opponent's rank.
player.highlights.wins.scope: Beside Notable wins: the opponents' ranks are on {community}'s board.
player.highlights.wins.scopeSized: Beside Notable wins: the opponents' ranks are on {community}'s board, which ranks {n} players.
player.highlights.wins.win: A win with no score recorded. Keep it one letter.
player.highlights.wins.won: Screen-reader word before a notable win's score.
player.history.column.rating: Tournament history column: the rating after that tournament.
player.history.column.team: Doubles history column: the team and the tournament.
player.history.enteredAs: After a tournament's name, the name the player entered under.
player.history.row: Accessible name of a history row: {place} is an ordinal (1st), {field} the field size, {event} the event.
player.history.rowUnplaced: Accessible name of a history row with no placement.
player.history.scope: Under the Tournaments heading when no community rates the game.
player.history.scopeRated: Under the Tournaments heading: attendance is lifetime, the rating column is {community}'s.
player.history.team.row: Accessible name of a doubles row: {unit} is teams or entrants, already a word; {team} is the team's name.
player.history.team.rowUnplaced: Accessible name of a doubles row with no placement.
player.hosted.title: Section heading: events this player organised.
player.masthead.alsoIn: Before links to the other games this player is in.
player.masthead.tournaments: After a formatted tournament count under an unranked player's name.
player.masthead.unranked: Under the name of a player with no rank on {community}'s board.
player.rail.title: Heading of the player profile's section rail.
player.rating.label: Name of the rating series in the rating chart.
player.rating.title: Section heading over the rating chart.
player.rating.tooltip.ranked: Rating chart tooltip: the player's rank on the board of {n} at that point.
player.results.entrants: After a field size in a results row.
player.section.h2h: Profile section and rail entry: one player's record against another.
player.section.hosted: Rail entry for the events this player organised.
player.section.rating: Rail entry for the rating history.
player.section.tournaments: Profile section and rail entry: tournament history.
